senses.gloss: m. pl. (יָצַק) [cast in a mould,] only in צִיקֵי קדרה a sort of pudding consisting of minced meats &c. mixed with wine and spices.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 77b:4">Ḥull. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>עשאן צ׳ ק׳</he> he minced them (the bones &c.) for a pudding.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86b:2">B. Mets. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>הללו לצ׳ ק׳</he> those (the animals mentioned <cite ref="I Kings 5:3">I Kings V, 3</cite>) were used for puddings.

<cite ref="Yoma 75a:18">Yoma 75ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>בשלו בפרור</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 11:8">Num. XI, 8</cite>) <he>מלמד שירד להם … צ׳ ק׳ וכ׳</he> this intimates that, with the manna, the ingredients for puddings came down &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 65a:6">Keth. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>יין לצ׳ ק׳</he> wine for puddings.
